subject.title: fix(cron): suppress control diagnostics in delivery

question: Should NO_SUBPROCESS_STARTED be a shared suppressed control reply across outbound surfaces, or a Matrix-only cron delivery exception?
rationale: Current main has a shared control-reply contract, while this PR intentionally makes the diagnostic Matrix-only; the permanent user-visible delivery policy needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Use Shared Control Reply Policy
options.body: Add NO_SUBPROCESS_STARTED to the shared classifier and cover cron plus gateway-visible surfaces so one suppression contract owns the token.

options.title: Approve Matrix-Only Exception
options.body: Keep suppression limited to Matrix cron delivery, but name and test the exception so non-Matrix delivery remains intentionally visible.

options.title: Leave Diagnostic Visible
options.body: Reject suppression for now if maintainers want this diagnostic to remain user-visible until a broader control-token policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Use Shared Control Reply Policy
recommendation.body: Add NO_SUBPROCESS_STARTED to the shared classifier and cover cron plus gateway-visible surfaces so one suppression contract owns the token.

likelyOwner.reason: Pinghuachiu introduced the shared classifier whose scope is the central product-policy question here.
